comments.body:
I have troubles pulling this quest. I have made both pre-quests "History hidden in lettering on a crest" and "Grave of the Mayan king". I have more than 120k adventure fame. Maybe there are some more hidden requirements, maybe I need battle fame.
I checked some Korean and Japanese sites, and I found some criteria for this quest which I do not understand:
Experience and fame 300/200
I wonder what do these numbers mean.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Look at the discovery card description, and consider the dialogue boxes leading up to it: you've been had. Outwitted. Fooled! Scheck von Wald stole the actual discovery right out from under you, and left a mocking faux artifact in its place to rub your nose in it. You'll have to pay him back for that... perhaps invite him to a banquet in his honor?
